morphology.pattern_note: di- 构成被动式，与词根连写；词根 usir 不变，i 与 u 分属相邻音节。输入包将 diusir 判为词根有误，此处按实际构词修正。

senses.zh_definition: 被驱逐；被强行赶离某个地方、住所或群体。
senses.en_definition: To be expelled, driven away, or forced to leave.
senses.ms_definition: Disuruh pergi dengan paksa; dihalau dari sesuatu tempat.
senses.nuances: 是 mengusir 的被动式，主语为被赶走的人或动物；通常带有强制、排斥或敌意，不等于一般的离开，也不自动表示依法遣返。词义依据：[DBP PRPM：usir 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1.aspx?d=73980&keyword=pengusir)。

collocations.en: be driven out of the house

senses.zh_definition: 被追赶；被追捕，主要见于古典叙事。
senses.en_definition: To be pursued or chased, especially in classical narrative.
senses.ms_definition: Dikejar atau diburu, khususnya dalam penggunaan sastera lama.
senses.nuances: 承接 usir 在旧文献中的“追赶、追捕”义。以下为帮助阅读古典语境而构造的搭配，不作为现代高频表达；现代通常用 dikejar 或 diburu。[DBP PRPM：usir 词族](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1.aspx?d=73980&keyword=pengusir)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Menurut laporan itu, beberapa keluarga telah diusir dari kediaman mereka tanpa notis awal.
dual_scenarios.zh: 据该报告，数户家庭在未收到事先通知的情况下被赶离住所。
dual_scenarios.en: According to the report, several families were forced out of their homes without prior notice.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Dia dah diusir dari rumah tu, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Dia sudah diusir dari rumah itu, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 他已经被赶出那间屋子了，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: He’s already been kicked out of that house, right?
spoken_features: dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略。
tu 是 itu 的口语缩略。
句末 kan 用于请求确认。
diusir 较书面；日常口语也常说 kena halau。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Amir dah diusir dari rumah sewa tu ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Amir sudah diusir dari rumah sewa itu?
messages.zh: 阿米尔已经被赶出租屋了吗？
messages.en: Has Amir been kicked out of that rented house?

messages.speaker: Nadia (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ya, dia kat rumah kakak dia sekarang. Dia nak cari bilik lain.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia berada di rumah kakaknya sekarang. Dia mahu mencari bilik lain.
messages.zh: 对，他现在住在姐姐家，想再找个房间。
messages.en: Yes, he’s staying at his sister’s now. He wants to find another room.

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two meanings of usir: pursuing someone and forcing someone away. This makes older stories potentially surprising: a person described as diusir may be chased rather than expelled. The prefix di- places the affected participant in focus. Modern everyday interpretation usually favours expulsion, while surrounding events help readers recover the older pursuit meaning. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1.aspx?d=73980&keyword=pengusir)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 usir＝赶走，再加 di-＝被：diusir 就是“被赶走”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 用于人时语气较重，容易让人感到受辱或被排斥。一般服务场景若只是请对方离开，可说 diminta beredar；确有强制驱逐时才用 diusir。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合新闻、叙事或准确描述被驱赶的经历；询问当事人时应照顾其尊严，避免把遭遇驱逐当作玩笑。
